title: Album release: King Biscuit Flower Hour Presents Ringo & His New All-Starr Band by Ringo Starr | 2002
content:
King Biscuit Flower Hour Presents Ringo & His New All-Starr Band, the fifth live album by Ringo Starr, was released on 6 August 2002.

It was recorded by the former Beatles drummer and the All-Starr Band at the Rosemont Theatre in Rosemont, Illinois, on 22 August 2001. It was the 20th show by the seventh All-Starr Band, whose tour of North America lasted for 28 dates between July and September 2001.

King Biscuit Flower Hour Presents Ringo & His New All-Starr Band failed to chart anywhere.

A DVD of the show was also released in 2002, containing the same songs plus ‘Cleveland Rocks’, ‘Things Can Only Get Better’, and ‘It Don’t Come Easy’.
